title: K-EXAONE Technical Report Journey to Frontier-Level Performance of Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the custom Korean Global Civic Safety Benchmark (KGC-SAFETY) and the Korea-Augmented Universal Taxonomy (K-AUT). An LLM-as-a-judge (gpt-4.1-mini) evaluates model responses against specific criteria to detect prejudice, discrimination (e.g., against North Korean defectors), and distortion of legal or constitutional status.

Assessed broadly under the 'Universal Human Values' and 'Social Safety' domains of the KGC-SAFETY benchmark. It uses an LLM-as-a-judge framework to provide binary safety judgments on prompt-response pairs containing multi-turn, multilingual, and adversarial test cases designed to trigger bias-related behaviors.

Measured within the 'Social Safety' category of the KGC-SAFETY benchmark using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect whether the model's responses generate harmful misinformation or exacerbate religious and ideological conflicts.
